label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is alert-TP. The variable 'trusted' is assigned from request.getAttribute('verifiedDisplayName') (Line 18) and written directly to the HTML response writer without encoding (Line 22). The resolved sink value depends on the attribute content, which is not proven to be a safe constant or sanitized. Concatenating request-derived data into HTML tags constitutes an XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: trusted retrieved from request attribute and echoed to HTML without encoding
